ws-relay.title: Bound the renewal wait with a deadline
ws-relay.body: `relay.renewed()` has no deadline. Pass a 2 second timeout so a lost renewal fails the test.

ws-relay.title: Key lease waiters by lease ID
ws-relay.body:
## Why

`renewed()` resumes every waiter, including ones for an older lease.

## Done when

- Waiters are keyed by lease ID
- `LeaseTests` cover two overlapping leases
